description_en: Invokes ModifyInstanceChargeType to convert the billing method of one or more Edge Node Service (ENS) instances. You can convert between instance-level pay-as-you-go and subscription instances. For instance-level pay-as-you-go instances, you can also convert pay-as-you-go cloud disks created with the instances to subscription cloud disks
description_zh: 调用ModifyInstanceChargeType更换一台或者多台ENS实例的计费方式。支持在实例级后付费实例和包年包月实例间相互转换，同时针对实例级后付费实例可以将随实例创建的后付费云盘转换为包年包月云盘
kebab_example: aliyun ens modify-instance-charge-type --instance-ids i-5xlrc9wdeo3xxxxxx --instance-charge-type PostPaid --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceChargeType

parameters.help_en: The target billing method of the instance. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
实例需要修改的目标计费方式。取值：

PrePaid：将实例级后付费实例转换为包年包月实例。

PostPaid：将包年包月实例转换为实例级后付费实例（默认值）
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal when converting the instance from pay-as-you-go to subscription. Valid values:

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
false: Auto-renewal is not enabled (default)
parameters.help_zh:
实例级后付费转为包年包月的时候是否开启自动续费。取值：

true：自动续费。

false：不自动续费（默认值）
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration when converting a pay-as-you-go instance to subscription. This parameter is required in this scenario. Valid values:

If PeriodUnit is set to Day, Period can only be set to 3.

If PeriodUnit is set to Month, Period can be set to 1-9 or 12
parameters.help_zh:
实例级后付费转为包年包月的时候的包年包月时长，如果是此场景下该字段必填。取值：

如果 PeriodUnit 取值为 Day 时，则 Period 仅可设置为 3。

如果 PeriodUnit 取值为 Month 时，则 Period 可设置为1-9,12
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration when converting an instance-level pay-as-you-go instance to a subscription instance. This parameter is required in this scenario. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
实例级后付费转为包年包月的时候的购买资源的时长单位，如果是此场景下该字段必填。取值：

Month：按月购买。

Day：按天购买
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to convert all pay-as-you-go data cloud disks created with the instance to subscription data cloud disks when converting an instance-level pay-as-you-go instance to a subscription instance. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
实例级后付费转为包年包月的时候是否将随实例创建的所有按量付费数据盘一起转换为包年包月数据盘。取值：

true：是。

false：否（默认值）
parameters.name: include_data_disks

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically complete the payment when you switch the billing method of the instance from pay-as-you-go to subscription. Valid values:

true: The payment is automatically completed. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient.

false: Only an order is generated but no payment is made. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
实例级后付费转为包年包月的时候是否自动支付。取值：

true：自动支付，您需要确保账户余额充足。

false：只生成订单不扣费（默认值）
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The billing cycle. Valid values: Month, Day, and Hour
parameters.help_zh: 计费周期。取值：Month（月）、Day（天）、Hour（小时）
parameters.name: billing_cycle
